measurements.scope: Tomczak and Godfrey report approximately 2,500 km for the Gulf Stream proper as an open-ocean free jet downstream of Cape Hatteras toward the Newfoundland Rise/Grand Banks near 50°W. This excludes the Florida Current and North Atlantic Current; it is a textbook path-scale description, not a measured reference streamline. NOAA's glossary uses the same strict segment definition, while NASA and NOAA Coast Pilot sometimes use Gulf Stream more broadly.

widths.geographic_scope: Cape Hatteras offshore fixed TR-038 baseline; three non-synoptic crossings in1967. Not the whole Gulf Stream or Gulf Stream System.
widths.layer: Transport per unit width integrated from surface to local bottom, with variable bathymetry. No fixed-depth width layer or surface-only speed boundary.
